examples.text: Door de overproductie werd de waarde van het product ontwaard
examples.translation: The overproduction caused the value of the product to be devalued.
examples.english: The overproduction caused the value of the product to be devalued.

examples.text: De munteenheid werd door de economische crisis snel ontwaard
examples.translation: The currency was quickly devalued due to the economic crisis.
examples.english: The currency was quickly devalued due to the economic crisis.

examples.text: De kwaliteit van het product is de laatste jaren sterk ontwaard.
examples.translation: The quality of the product has greatly debased in recent years.
examples.english: The quality of the product has greatly debased in recent years.
